items.classification: All 59 P2f modules compared with ON emissions (every eligible PCQ/PCQC/PCQE/PCQF emission is overflow-checks ON). RPz7_FIo_NativeFuns mixes checked field arithmetic and wrapping fast_pairing/transport/reduce_u64 bodies: the ruling (per module) cannot be applied to a mixed module; applied per definition (required OFF where the ON comparison shows a checked/wrapping operator difference). Reported to the lead as a question about the ruling, not decided.

OFF record checked: reduce, Dot.finish, EbyKDot.push, EbyKDot.finish have a P2a PROVED_UNFOLD against the receipted OFF emission PCQ_E415 (P1b, exit 0) in PCUA_L006 (exit 0, 37 #print axioms lines, standard only); consolidated status takes those. Variant.row_loop.body/row_loop/row: P2a FAILED against PCQ_E410 (OFF) with the library mismatch `Usize.wrapping_shr j i` (shift amount Usize in the emission, U32 in the gate library): no OFF theorem exists and the generator drops the non-elaborating declaration, so a rerun would be unchanged; stays FAILED (P3). NMT_stage1_owned stage1_owned: P2d FAILED transport-needed against the OFF extraction; stays FAILED. aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 (FIo_NativeFuns and NFN_ExtractedGeometry): gate wrapping, no OFF emission declares it: CONFIG_MISMATCH_NO_OFF_RESULT.

PCQC_E002/E003/E004/E011 and PCQ_E039/E040 are excluded from the index (eligible=false). Modules whose earlier proofs used them were regenerated against the replacements; no earlier proof against a superseded emission is carried (status PROVED_AGAINST_SUPERSEDED_EMISSION_NOT_REPROVED count 0).

The gate M31.mul (AspisR72Sampler, AspisV8R19 slices, RPz7_FIo_NativeFuns, NFN) has a canonical fast path (`if self < P then if rhs < P then <single fold + conditional subtract> else reduce_u64`) that the frozen crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs M31::mul (= M31(reduce_u64(a*b))) does not have. FAILED/semantic with the exact diff in PCUF_EQ_STATUS.json; the two agree mathematically on canonical inputs (a P3 lemma, not proved here). Not relabelled as a transport item.

Genuine discharge, not a rename. Before: PCVA_L050 took the fresh opaque `aspis_core.field.P : Result U32` as `ok gate.P` (hypothesis, theorems PROVED_CONDITIONAL_ON_H_P). After: PCQF_E002 emits `def aspis_core.field.P : Std.U32 := 2147483647#u32`; PRVEq_TD_HP_P3f.lean uses the verbatim emitted declarations (attributes stripped) and proves P_eq, body_refines, body_cont, loop_refines, digest_is_canonical_eq, first_canonical_byte_eq, output_lane_eq (PCUF_L015 exit 0, axioms standard). Changed: the fresh body no longer binds P with `←`; the fresh pair_forest_accounts.first_canonical_byte is included (previously the gate constant was used); quantifiers and conclusions unchanged. Retained: the fresh first_canonical_byte calls atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical, which PCQF_E002 does not define and which resolves by name to the gate constant, so first_canonical_byte_eq and output_lane_eq hold relative to that identification (the PCQE_E002 encode_digest_canonical emission is not paired here). The result is a refinement of the loop-return encoding (Option Bool vs Bool), not a plain equality.

items.classification: Native02..11 passes treat declarations of imported lower-numbered gate modules as gate names. A proved equality for a callee defined in an imported gate module is stated against the compiled gate constant; the callee equality itself is proved in the pass of its own module. This is a model/transport change in the generator only; no gate or fresh text is edited.

The 60 GATE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE definitions: 45 now NO_FRESH_EMISSION (no eligible emission declares the name), 13 PROVED, 1 FAILED, 1 CONFIG_MISMATCH. The selected namespace block(s) are compared; declarations in other namespaces of the same gate file are not compared (recorded in the reports).

PCQE emissions are used in the same passes as the b59d5188-extended ones, with the tool recorded per pass (PCUF_PLAN.json passes[].tool, PCUF_ALL_STATUS aeneas_tool); compiled against the gate-compatible Aeneas Lean library. Where their declarations proved, the proof stands. The failing ones (pair_tree_profile / pair_terminal decoders from PCQE_E008, PCQE_E002 encode_digest_canonical chain) are recorded transport-needed with the probe error; whether the cause is the original-vs-extended Aeneas output was NOT analysed here.

See PCUF_ALL_STATUS.json selection_rule. 265 definitions have only a record without a correct basis (flagged basis_not_correct): mainly P5/P2a/P2d proofs against retained or OFF emissions for checked gate modules; they are kept visible but are not counted as proved-with-correct-basis (503 are).
